designNotes: Signals are biological OBSERVATIONS only. Legacy scoringSignals[] codes that encode protocol routing (KIT_GENDER_RESOLVER, VEG_KIT_SWAP, GI_GOLD_INJECTION, MPHL_FPHL_PLUS_VARIANT, etc.) are NOT promoted to Signals — they will migrate to Protocol Intelligence registries. Legacy codes that encode cause priors (AGA_GENETICS, TE_STRESS_SCORE numeric weights) are decomposed: the biological observation becomes a Signal here; the cause prior weighting migrates to registries/causes/priors. Legacy hard locks (PREGNANCY_LOCK, AGA_GRADE45_LOCK) emit a Signal AND register an EligibilityRule + RecoveryFloor downstream.

signals.name: Pattern Thinning Marker
signals.description: Self-observed widening parting or visible thinning in patterned distribution. Classic AGA/FPHL morphology signal.

signals.name: Diffuse Telogen Shedding Marker
signals.description: Full-length hairs released with intact white bulb — classic telogen-phase release.

signals.name: Shaft Breakage Marker
signals.description: Broken short hair fragments rather than full-length release. Indicates cortical/cuticle compromise.

signals.name: Patchy Loss Marker
signals.description: Circular bald patches or coin-sized spots. Hallmark autoimmune follicular targeting morphology.

signals.name: Active Shedding (50–100/day)
signals.description: Patient-counted daily shedding in the 50–100 range. Above resting telogen.

signals.name: Active Shedding (100+/day)
signals.description: Patient-counted daily shedding exceeding 100 strands.

signals.name: Thinning Without Visible Shedding
signals.description: Patient reports density loss without active fall — consistent with miniaturization rather than telogen release.

signals.name: Acute Duration (≤6 months)
signals.description: Onset within last 6 months — favors telogen mechanisms over established miniaturization.

signals.name: Subacute Duration (6–12 months)
signals.description: Onset 6–12 months ago — chronic TE territory; miniaturization may begin to unmask.

signals.name: Chronic Duration (>1 year)
signals.description: More than 12 months — established miniaturization or chronic inflammatory phenotype likely.

signals.name: Severity Grade 1–3
signals.description: Mild-to-moderate visible loss. Follicular reserve largely preserved.

signals.name: Severity Grade 4–5
signals.description: Extensive or near-complete loss. Follicular reserve significantly depleted; reversibility ceiling lowered.

signals.name: Dandruff Presence
signals.description: Visible flaking attributable to seborrheic activity and microbiome imbalance.

signals.name: Dandruff + Itching (Seborrheic Dermatitis Pattern)
signals.description: Co-occurring flaking and pruritus — strong seborrheic dermatitis pattern with active inflammatory component.

signals.name: Oily Scalp
signals.description: Excess sebum production. Contextual: in males or females 30+, raises miniaturization risk; in younger females, indicates inflammatory phenotype.

signals.name: Dry Scalp
signals.description: Insufficient sebum / barrier dryness.

signals.name: Scalp Redness / Irritation
signals.description: Visible erythema. Active inflammatory marker.

signals.name: Scalp Pustules / Boils
signals.description: Pustular lesions indicating bacterial/inflammatory follicular involvement.

signals.name: Scalp Burning Sensation
signals.description: Patient-reported burning — neurogenic inflammatory marker.

signals.name: Psoriatic Scalp
signals.description: Psoriasis-pattern scalp involvement: thick scaling, plaque morphology.

signals.name: Normal Scalp
signals.description: No notable scalp pathology reported. Used as protective/anti-inflammation prior.

signals.name: Family History of Hair Loss
signals.description: Patient reports family history pointing to genetic susceptibility.

signals.name: Chronic Stress / Anxiety / Depression
signals.description: Patient-reported psychological load. HPA-axis driver of telogen disruption.

signals.name: Hair-Pulling Behavior
signals.description: Self-reported repeated pulling. Mechanical follicular trauma over time.

signals.name: Self-Reported Nutritional Cause
signals.description: Patient attributes loss to nutritional deficiency.

signals.name: Post Medication / Illness / Surgery
signals.description: Hair loss attributed to recent medical event — classic acute TE trigger.

signals.name: Post Partum (Lactating)
signals.description: Currently breastfeeding — physiological hormonal transition.

signals.name: Post Partum (Not Lactating)
signals.description: Recent delivery, weaned — hormonal transition phase.

signals.name: GLP-1 Receptor Agonist (<6 months)
signals.description: Rapid weight loss from GLP-1 within last 6 months — acute substrate-deficit + TE trigger.

signals.name: GLP-1 Receptor Agonist (>6 months)
signals.description: GLP-1 use beyond 6-month window — chronic substrate-deficit risk.

signals.name: Crash Diet / Keto / Intermittent Fasting
signals.description: Severely restrictive dietary pattern. Substrate-deficit risk.

signals.name: Irregular / Poor Diet
signals.description: Patient reports inconsistent or low-quality dietary intake.

signals.name: Vegetarian Diet
signals.description: Plant-based diet — modifier for nutrient (heme iron, B12) availability.

signals.name: Vegan Diet
signals.description: Fully plant-based — elevated nutrient-availability modifier.

signals.name: High-Protein Diet
signals.description: Self-reported high-protein intake — modifier for androgen-axis dynamics.

signals.name: Iron Deficiency / Anaemia
signals.description: Patient reports diagnosed iron deficiency or anaemia. Direct substrate constraint on follicle.

signals.name: Vitamin D3 Deficiency
signals.description: Patient reports diagnosed Vitamin D3 deficiency.

signals.name: Vitamin B12 Deficiency
signals.description: Patient reports B12 deficiency — impairs follicle matrix cell proliferation.

signals.name: Hypothyroidism
signals.description: Diagnosed hypothyroidism. Direct hormonal driver of TE + miniaturization.

signals.name: Hyperthyroidism
signals.description: Diagnosed hyperthyroidism.

signals.name: Pre-Diabetes
signals.description: Patient reports pre-diabetic state. Insulin-resistance precursor.

signals.name: Diabetes
signals.description: Diagnosed diabetes.

signals.name: Obesity / Sedentary
signals.description: BMI/lifestyle pattern indicating insulin-androgen axis perturbation.

signals.name: Heavy Gym / Bodybuilding
signals.description: Intensive resistance training pattern — androgen-axis modifier.

signals.name: Smoking / Vaping
signals.description: Tobacco/nicotine exposure — ROS load and vasoactive effects.

signals.name: Alcohol (Frequent)
signals.description: Regular alcohol intake — hepatic/oxidative load and nutrient interference.

signals.name: Night Shift Work
signals.description: Shift-work circadian disruption.

signals.name: Frequent Flying
signals.description: Frequent time-zone shifts — circadian and oxidative load.

signals.name: Alopecia Areata History
signals.description: Diagnosed or self-identified history of alopecia areata.

signals.name: Recurrent Infections / Cold / Fever
signals.description: Frequent infections — immune-compromise marker.

signals.name: Allergy Cluster
signals.description: Allergic atopy.

signals.name: Asthma History
signals.description: Chronic asthma.

signals.name: Skin Rashes / Eczema
signals.description: Atopic dermatitis or eczema history.

signals.name: Scarring Alopecia
signals.description: Cicatricial alopecia — follicular destruction with scarring. Hard recovery ceiling.

signals.name: Mouth Ulcers (Co-Occurring with Gut)
signals.description: Recurrent mouth ulcers with gut symptoms — mucosal/inflammatory composite.

signals.name: GERD / Acid Reflux
signals.description: Chronic acid reflux. Absorption and microbiome impact.

signals.name: IBS / Crohn's / Constipation
signals.description: Inflammatory bowel / dysmotility pattern. Strong gut signal.

signals.name: Bloating / Gas
signals.description: Common dysbiosis/dysmotility marker.

signals.name: PCOS / PCOD
signals.description: Polycystic ovary syndrome — androgen-axis perturbation in females.

signals.name: PCOS + Metabolic Co-Pattern
signals.description: PCOS with obesity/weight/insulin-resistance overlay.

signals.name: Endometriosis
signals.description: Diagnosed endometriosis.

signals.name: Currently Pregnant
signals.description: Active pregnancy. Hard eligibility floor for many therapies; not itself a hair pathology.

signals.name: Peri-menopause
signals.description: Reproductive-transition state with fluctuating estrogen/androgen ratio.

signals.name: Menopause
signals.description: Menopausal state.

signals.name: Post-menopause
signals.description: Post-menopausal — chronic low-estrogen state.

signals.name: Hormone Replacement Therapy (HRT)
signals.description: Active HRT — exogenous hormonal modifier.

signals.name: Chronic Medical Condition on Medication
signals.description: Patient on long-term medication for chronic condition. Comorbidity + potential pharmacologic effect on hair cycle.

signals.name: Heat Styling Exposure
signals.description: Frequent heat-tool use.

signals.name: Chemical Treatment Exposure
signals.description: Color, keratin, perming exposures.

signals.name: Hard Water Exposure
signals.description: Self-reported hard-water exposure — cumulative mineral deposition affecting shaft and scalp barrier.

signals.name: Early Greying
signals.description: Self-reported premature greying.

signals.name: Age Modifier — Young (<25)
signals.description: Age band under 25.

signals.name: Age Modifier — Senior (>55)
signals.description: Age over 55.

signals.name: Sex — Male
signals.description: Male — MPHL prior.

signals.name: Sex — Female
signals.description: Female — FPHL/hormonal-axis priors.

signals.name: Goal — Regrowth Focus
signals.description: Patient goal is regrowth (post-stabilization).
